messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High rate of auth failures for tenant HarborPoint in private VPC (dedicated pool). 401/403 spikes observed starting ~10:03 UTC. Paging on-call.
harborpoint-support: seeing ~12% 401s for /api/v1/customer-data across three services. Customer confirms they did a key rotation ~09:58 UTC on their IdP side.
elaine: i'm on it, looking at logs now. PD page received. tagging raj and sre-jen.
raj: thanks. do we know if this is only token verification errors (kid not found) or something else?
sre-jen: logs: `oidc: token validation failed: jwk lookup failed: kid "b4f2" not found in cached JWKS` — repeated across requests. past few minutes show increased JWKS fetch failures: 504 from customer JWKS endpoint.
tomi: hm, customer-side rotation + intermittent jwks fetch = likely cache staleness on our identity-proxy inside their VPC. If the proxy didn't pull new JWKS after rotation and customer rotated to a new KID, the cached keys no longer cover new tokens.
harborpoint-support: they confirmed the new key propagated on their side around 09:59 and the public JWKS endpoint is healthy now (200). but our metrics show upstream jwks fetch latencies spiked earlier.
elaine: can we force a JWKS refresh on the identity-proxy? any admin endpoints?
sre-jen: yes, identity-proxy exposes an admin flush for this customer deployment. running now from bastion:

```
# flush cache on k8s deployment in customer VPC
kubectl --context=harborpoint-prod -n harborpoint exec deploy/identity-proxy -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -s -XPOST http://localhost:8081/admin/cache/flush'
# or trigger a rollout restart
kubectl --context=harborpoint-prod -n harborpoint rollout restart deploy/identity-proxy
```

deploybot: started rollout restart (deploy/identity-proxy) @ harborpoint-prod. watch: `kubectl -n harborpoint rollout status deploy/identity-proxy`
elaine: doing the admin flush first, then restart if residual errors. posting live command output:

```
> curl -XPOST http://10.0.1.12:8081/admin/cache/flush
{"status":"ok","flushed":"jwks"}
```

elaine: flush returned ok. waiting to see traffic.
ops-bot: metric update: 401 rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8% over 45s after flush. some traces still failing (stale tokens in flight).
raj: good. can we validate that the new public key appear in the JWKS our proxies are using?
sre-jen: fetched local JWKS from proxy after flush: contains kid `b4f2` and `9a7c` — matches customer-provided keys. confirmed with `curl https://idp.harborpoint.com/.well-known/jwks.json` and diff.
elain: (typo) — elaine: confirmed with harborpoint-support that post-rotation tokens were being signed with `b4f2` and are now verifying.
harborpoint-support: customer impact reduced to a handful of timeouts; they see normal traffic for most users. thanks for the quick response.
raj: root cause hypothesis: customer rotated keys and their JWKS endpoint responded slowly during propagation window. our proxy cached the older JWKS and didn't retry aggressively; when new tokens arrived with the new KID, validation failed until cache was flushed.
tomi: mitigation path:
- short-term: admin-flush + restart identity-proxy (done)
- medium: add a background JWKS refresh on rotation detection + exponential backoff retry to fetch jwks when kid-miss occurs
- add alert: repeated `kid not found` errors for tenant X -> auto-page and increase jwks refresh frequency
- consider adding a fallback to fetch JWKS synchronously on kid miss (with rate-limit) rather than relying solely on cache

elaine: actions created: INCIDENT-7821 (harborpoint jwks cache miss). I'll own the follow-up. tagging product and eng-ml for potential runtime change.
raj: handoff: i'm taking primary for next 2 hours to keep watch and coordinate with harborpoint's IdP team. elaine, if you want to rest, ack and handoff accepted.
elaine: handing off to raj. will add detailed timeline to the ticket and include the flush + restart commands, logs, and metric snapshots. :thumbsup:
harborpoint-support: appreciate the quick fix. please keep us posted on any changes to the proxy behavior — customer security team is reviewing rotation policy.
ops-bot: post-incident note: recorded bake time for restart ~ 28s, flush success at 2065432112. next steps: schedule a runbook update and add e2e test for JWKS rotation.
incident-bot: INCIDENT STATUS: mitigated -> monitoring. severity: P2. liaison assigned: raj. next update expected within 2 hours.
